Metadata and contract are sufficient to exclude semantic equivalence; no runtime test was required for this unrelated contract.

rules.reason: Format method on z.string(). Its contract is: Use the Zod 4 top-level format checks like `z.email()`, `z.uuid()`, or `z.ipv4()` instead of `z.string().<format>()`. This library compatibility/correctness contract is independent of the guideline caching, scheduling and render-allocation mechanisms.
